tables.name: public.checklist_overview
tables.view:
SELECT i.id,
    i.task_id,
    t.project_id,
    i.percentage,
    i.is_completed,
    i.comment,
    i.deadline_at,
    i.sync_version
   FROM (public.task_items i
     JOIN public.tasks t ON ((t.id = i.task_id)))
  WHERE ((NOT i.is_archived) AND (t.status <> 'archived'::public.task_status) AND ((public.get_task_project_context(t.id) ->> 'status'::text) = 'active'::text));
